init.title: Water cost
init.description: Price per gallon, in your Home Assistant currency, including any per-unit surcharges and taxes. When set, the integration also writes a "SJ Water Hub Water Cost" statistic for the Energy dashboard. A new price applies from now on; earlier hours keep the price they were recorded with. Leave empty to turn cost tracking off.
